song.title: Why'd You Only Call Me When You're High_

guitar.modelsText: Fender Jazzmaster / Gibson Les Paul / Gretsch
guitar.notes: Turner has used Jazzmasters, Gibson ES-335/Les Pauls, and various others over the band's career; no single iconic instrument, so medium confidence is appropriate.

tone.target: jangly indie rock crunch with dry bite and subtle delay
tone.profile: jangly indie rock crunch with dry bite and subtle delay
tone.summary: A tight, mid-forward signal chain using a mild boost/overdrive into a classic UK combo amp model, paired with a bright cab and minimal digital delay to capture the required jangle and clarity.

rig.name: Arctic Monkeys - Why'd You Only Call Me When You're High_ - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight pick attack.
Provide the necessary mid-forward crunch and edge of breakup without heavy fuzz.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is chosen for its classic, non-aggressive overdrive character suitable for indie rock bite.

alternatives.reason: A slightly more aggressive alternative if the crunch needs to be louder.

blocks.purpose: Bypass or use a very subtle gain boost if needed; keeping the tone clean here.
blocks.gap: The Green OD handles the required crunch, so no dedicated distortion unit is necessary.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the British combo amp and provide mid-forward clarity for jangly tones.
blocks.gap: The UK 50 is ideal for classic, articulate indie rock sounds.

alternatives.reason: A good alternative if the tone needs to be slightly more aggressive.

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright, articulate cabinet sound matching the British combo feel.
blocks.gap: The UK Vintage 4x12 offers the necessary brightness and punch for indie rock clarity.

alternatives.reason: A slightly more open, less defined sound.

blocks.purpose: Fine-tune the tone to emphasize mid-range bite and clarity.
blocks.gap: Used for surgical EQ adjustments to achieve the 'mid-forward crunch' requirement.

blocks.purpose: Provide a light, rhythmic delay that enhances the jangle without being dominant.
blocks.gap: Settings are kept minimal to ensure the delay is subtle and supportive, not leading the song.

alternatives.reason: A warmer alternative if the digital sound is too artificial.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle space and dimension without sounding lush or muddy.
blocks.gap: Used sparingly to provide depth, avoiding the 'lush reverb' trap.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the current IR for one that better captures the bright, articulate sound of a British combo amp.

proposals.reason: The current 4x12 might be too large/dark for the required jangly, articulate bite.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and definition in the mids.
